description: Source code for a launcher class that manages remote execution of Cobalt tools on RDK devices via pexpect, including process control, SSH interactions, and test execution automation.

classes.name: Launcher
classes.description: A class for launching and managing Cobalt tools on RDK devices via SSH and pexpect, including process control, retries, and test execution.

methods.name: _InitPexpectCommands
methods.description: Initializes commands for rsync, ssh, and test setup.

methods.name: _ShutdownBackoff
methods.description: Performs backoff and checks if shutdown is initiated.

methods.name: _PexpectSpawnAndConnect
methods.description: Spawns a pexpect process and connects to RDK, handling login prompts.

methods.name: _PexpectSendLine
methods.description: Sends a command line to the pexpect process.

methods.name: _PexpectReadLines
methods.description: Reads lines from pexpect process output, detecting test completion.

methods.name: _Sleep
methods.description: Sends sleep command and waits for completion.

methods.name: _CleanupPexpectProcess
methods.description: Closes and cleans up the pexpect process.

methods.name: _WaitForPrompt
methods.description: Waits until the shell prompt appears.

methods.name: _KillExistingCobaltProcesses
methods.description: Kills leftover Cobalt processes on the device.

methods.name: Run
methods.description: Main method to execute the test process on the device, including setup, execution, and cleanup.

methods.name: Kill
methods.description: Stops the launcher run, initiating shutdown.

methods.name: GetDeviceOutputPath
methods.description: Returns the path for test output files.
